This script runs a principal component analysis (PCA) of the seven log antibody levels, then asks whether the principal components predict cryptococcosis status. The correlation plots and PCA plots are drawn in [Figures](figures.qmd), and the eigenvalue table in [Tables](tables.qmd).

## Why PCA

The antibody levels are correlated with one another, most strongly GXM-IgM with Lam-IgM, which makes their individual coefficients in a joint regression model unstable. PCA replaces the seven correlated measurements with seven uncorrelated components that keep all of their variance [@yoon2022antibody].

## Fit the PCA

PCA is run on the log antibody levels of participants with complete antibody data. `scale = TRUE` standardizes each antibody first, so that no single antibody dominates because of its units.
